name: Normal Skin
description: Normal skin is characterized by a balanced appearance with neither excess oil nor dryness. It typically has an even texture, minimal visible pores, and a healthy complexion.

morning_routine.action: Cleanse the face gently with a mild cleanser.
morning_routine.purpose: Remove impurities and prepare skin for moisturization.

morning_routine.action: Apply a lightweight moisturizer or serum to hydrate the skin.
morning_routine.purpose: Provide necessary hydration and support the skin barrier.

morning_routine.action: Protect your skin with a broad-spectrum SPF moisturizer.
morning_routine.purpose: Prevent UV damage and maintain healthy skin texture.

night_routine.action: Gently cleanse the face to remove dirt, oil, and makeup.
night_routine.purpose: Prepare the skin for overnight repair and hydration.

night_routine.action: Use a hydrating serum or lightweight moisturizer.
night_routine.purpose: Help retain moisture and support natural skin regeneration while you sleep.

weekly_care: Exfoliate once or twice a week to remove dead skin cells and promote cell turnover.
lifestyle_tips: Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water.
Maintain a balanced diet rich in fruits, vegetables, and antioxidants.
Protect your skin from the sun by using sunscreen daily.
do: Regularly cleanse and moisturize your skin.
Apply sunscreen every day to protect against UV damage.
Drink plenty of water to maintain hydration.
dont: Skip the use of sunscreen, even on cloudy days.
Use overly heavy products that can clog pores or cause irritation.
Over-exfoliate which can lead to skin dryness and irritation.

seasonal_care.summer: Use lighter, oil-free moisturizers and increase sun protection.
seasonal_care.winter: Switch to richer moisturizers and consider using a humidifier.
seasonal_care.monsoon: Maintain regular skincare routines but be extra gentle with cleansing.

expert_tips: Regularly assess your skin type and adjust products as needed.
Consult a dermatologist for personalized advice if concerns arise.
